items.title: What It's Like Inside Emirates' New Airbus A350-900
items.summary: Tom and Alejandro of Simple Flying take a full tour of Emirates' brand-new Airbus A350-900 from the Farnborough Airshow 2026. From the airline's all-new Business Class and expanded Premium Economy cabin to its upgraded ice inflight entertainment system and redesigned Economy Class, they explore every cabin, highlight the aircraft's latest features, and take a closer look at what passengers can expect when flying on Emirates' newest widebody.

items.title: It’s Official: Boeing 737 MAX 7 Secures FAA Type Certification
items.summary: The Boeing 737 MAX 7 has finally been cleared for commercial service, more than eight years after the smallest member of the 737 MAX family first took to the skies. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) granted Boeing an amended type certificate for the aircraft on Monday, August 3rd, bringing one of the manufacturer’s longest-running certification programs to an end.
